name: Potassium chloride
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 40 to 100 mEq/day in divided doses; no more than 40 mEq per dose; with meals
Must be diluted before use; never IV push. Rate and concentration per the IV product label; in kidney impairment use the low end with ECG monitoring as needed.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: ACE inhibitors, ARBs, spironolactone, eplerenone, aliskiren

common: Nausea, vomiting, flatulence, abdominal pain, diarrhea
serious: Gastrointestinal ulceration, stricture, bleeding, perforation (solid forms)

pk.excretion_renal_pct: Potassium excreted mainly by the kidney
